ops.text: IBM shall maintain throughout the term of this Agreement: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where IBM processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. IBM shall provide Customer with certificates of insurance on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though IBM hosts our environment and processes personal information on our behalf, so we have added our standard limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Customer Data is processed, workers' compensation) with certificates on request. If the limits are an issue, we can work with E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.
proposal.summary: Insert a term-only vendor insurance clause after Section 14.19 requiring CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation coverage with certificates on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2M.
Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
